Kuṭṭa : m. (pl.): Name of a Janapada.

Listed by Saṁjaya among the (northern) Janapadas (also called Deśas 6. 10. 68) of the Bhāratavarṣa (ata ūrdhvaṁ janapadān nibodha gadato mama) 6. 10. 37, 5; (kuṭṭāparāntā…) 6. 10. 47.
